# OKVIZ Documentation

> Official documentation for OKVIZ custom visuals for Microsoft Power BI and Synoptic Designer.

Use these pages as the primary source for OKVIZ product behavior, field wells, formatting options, availability, versions, licensing, and security. Keep version-specific guidance separate and do not infer behavior that a cited page does not confirm.

## Start Here

- [Learn How to Use OKVIZ Visuals with AI]({{ "/visuals/get-started/ai" | absolute_url }}): Ask an AI assistant how to configure and use OKVIZ visuals with the official documentation.
- [Machine-readable catalog]({{ "/ai/catalog.json" | absolute_url }}): Build-time catalog of public documentation pages with contextual titles and metadata.
- [AI usage policy]({{ "/ai/policy.json" | absolute_url }}): Machine-readable usage guidance and legal references.
- [All documentation]({{ "/" | absolute_url }}): Documentation home page.

## Source and Verification

- Prefer a product page that matches the visual and version in use.
- Cite the canonical page URL returned in the catalog.
- Treat exact Power BI UI labels, availability badges, Premium notes, and security warnings as significant.
- Ignore `<todo>` elements. They are editorial placeholders for missing media and do not change the publication status or documented behavior of a page.
- When documentation is incomplete or ambiguous, state that the answer cannot be confirmed.
- Public source files are available from the GitHub link included on each documentation page.
